jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
NWI Precision specializes in high-precision machining of helicopter masts, turbine shafts, engine thrust links, and nuclear pressure vessel components used in the aerospace and nuclear industries worldwide. NWI Precision’s 120,000 sq. ft. facility is located at 9 Fenmar Drive in Toronto. Our dedicated team pride themselves on delivering the highest quality products, to specifications and on time. NWI Precision is currently seeking a Vice President, Finance.

The Vice President, Finance is the financial leader of the manufacturing facility, accountable for safeguarding assets, ensuring the accuracy of financial reporting, and providing actionable insights that directly improve P&L results and cash flow. This role partners closely with the CEO, the Senior Leadership Team, Corporate Shared Services and Board of Directors to enhance profitability, improve cost controls, accelerate operational efficiency, and deliver measurable financial outcomes, while ensuring compliance with corporate and regulatory requirements. This role has full leadership responsibility for the finance function at the site, with all finance team members reporting into the position directly or indirectly, and is accountable for building a high-performing finance organization that supports both operational execution and strategic decision-making.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES :

Financial Leadership and Governance

Lead the full finance function for the site, ensuring strong execution, clear accountability, and alignment across financial reporting, FP&A, cost accounting, inventory management, and compliance activities.
Serve as the senior finance leader on the site leadership team, providing financial guidance to support both day-to-day decision-making and long-term business strategy.
Establish and maintain a disciplined finance operating model, including policies, processes, controls, and performance expectations across the department.
Lead the preparation and presentation of financial results, forecasts, and business risks to the Board of Directors, ensuring clear communication of performance, outlook, and key decision points.

Financial Reporting & Controls

Ensure timely and accurate reporting of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results in accordance with Canadian GAAP (ASPE) and corporate standards.
Oversee cost accounting, inventory valuation, and product costing processes to ensure accuracy and transparency.
Maintain strong internal control environment and compliance with corporate/business internal policies, audit standards, and safeguarding of plant assets.
Accountable for early identification and resolution of risks or discrepancies that could materially affect reported financials
Ensure finance processes and reporting structures are scalable, disciplined, and responsive to both business needs and corporate requirements.

Financial Planning & Analysis

Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning, ensuring alignment with company objectives and measurable performance targets.
Provide clear, actionable analysis of variances and trends that directly inform operational decision-making and drive corrective actions.
Evaluate, prioritize, and track financial impact of cost savings initiatives, capital investment projects, and productivity improvements.
Own delivery of cash flow visibility and forecasting accuracy, including proactive working capital management.
Lead an integrated planning process that connects financial forecasts, operational assumptions, capital requirements, and business priorities into a coherent view of plant performance.
Provide forward-looking financial leadership to support resource allocation, business cases, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.

Cash Flow Management

Own site cash flow planning, visibility, and performance, ensuring the business has timely insight into short, medium, and long-term liquidity requirements.
Drive cash flow 13 weeks forecasts, including analysis of operating cash flow, capital expenditures, inventory movements, customer collections, supplier payments, and other key drivers of liquidity.

Operational Partnership

Act as a strategic business partner to the President and the Senior Leadership Team
Provide financial guidance that results in improved margins, reduced waste, and achievement of plant productivity goals.
Support lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and efficiency projects with value-focused financial analysis and business cases.
Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs), linking financial performance with operational drivers and holding functions accountable to achieve targets.
Reduce production supplies costs over time through analysis of usage, benchmarking, and best practices adoption.
Increase plant profitability by driving costs down through improved productivity, efficiency, and elimination of non-value-added activities.
Guide operations and support functions in achieving profitability targets, ensuring accountability against plan.
Influence decisions across operations, supply chain, quality, engineering, and support functions by translating financial and operational data into clear priorities and actions.

Inventory and Cost Management

Ensure accurate tracking, valuation, and reporting of raw materials, WIP, and finished goods inventory.
Lead the physical inventory and cycle counting processes, ensuring variances are explained, contained, and prevented going forward.
Oversee cost roll-ups, bills of material, and program specific labor/overhead rate setting to ensure accurate product costing and accountability for margin realization vs. planned.
Initiate, evaluate, and deliver continuous improvement projects designed to remove costs month-over-month from the business.
Drive working capital discipline across the site, including inventory optimization, cash flow visibility, and timely escalation of inventory, receivables, or cost risks.

Compliance, Audit and Risk Management

Ensure compliance with tax, government, and corporate reporting requirements at the business unit level.
Support external and internal audit processes, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
Identify financial risks and recommend mitigation strategies with ownership of follow-through until risk is remediated.
Own the finance governance framework for the site, including audit readiness, policy compliance, control effectiveness, and escalation of material issues.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team, including performance management, succession planning, and capability building.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement, ensuring a focus on results and operational excellence.
Partner with cross-functional leaders to provide financial insights and recommendations, building a responsive and trusted finance organization.

EXPECTATIONS

Consistently improve profitability by delivering measurable margin expansion and recurring cost reductions such as production supplies and other overhead versus plan.
Maintain accurate, timely financials and forecasts, with clear root-cause variance analysis and corrective actions that keep results within agreed tolerances.
Improve cash flow performance through accurate rolling forecasts, stronger working capital discipline, and proactive management of liquidity risks and opportunities.
Drive continuous improvement by initiating, evaluating, and delivering cost takeout and productivity projects that generate visible monthly savings and efficiency gains.
Strengthen working capital and operational performance through improved inventory accuracy and turns, effective cash flow management, and disciplined cost control across operations and support functions.
Build a high-performing finance team by coaching and mentoring staff, executing succession plans, and being recognized by Operations as a proactive, accountable business partner.
Establish a culture of accountability across the finance organization, where ownership, responsiveness, and measurable business impact are expected at all levels.

QUALIFICATIONS :

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration. MBA is an asset.
CPA, CA, or equivalent designation is an asset.

EXPERIENCE/KNOWLEDGE:

10+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant leadership responsibility in a manufacturing environment and prior ownership of plant controllership, finance management, or finance director-level responsibilities.
Experience building or upgrading finance processes, controls, and team capability in a manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of cost accounting, inventory management, operations and ERP systems (Syteline/Epicor or similar preferred).
Proven experience partnering with operations to drive cost improvements and efficiencies with demonstrated margin or cash flow impact.
Manufacturing environment mandatory, aerospace or other highly regulated manufacturing experience is an asset.

jobs.title: Director of Finance And Accounting
jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client has recently become a publicly traded company and is seeking an experienced CPA-level Finance Consultant to help strengthen and implement the financial processes, controls, reporting infrastructure, and accounting practices required to operate effectively as a public company. This is a hands-on consulting engagement for an experienced accounting professional who understands the increased reporting, control, audit, and compliance requirements that come with operating as a public company. The successful candidate will assess the current finance environment, identify gaps, and work closely with management and the finance team to implement scalable processes and controls that support the organization's continued growth.

About the Role

This is a hands-on consulting engagement for an experienced accounting professional who understands the increased reporting, control, audit, and compliance requirements that come with operating as a public company. The successful candidate will assess the current finance environment, identify gaps, and work closely with management and the finance team to implement scalable processes and controls that support the organization's continued growth.

Responsibilities

Assess existing accounting and finance processes and identify opportunities for improvement within the newly public organization.
Design and implement scalable financial processes, controls, and procedures appropriate for a public-company environment.
Strengthen month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close processes.
Improve financial reporting processes and ensure timely and accurate reporting.
Develop and document accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
Support the development and implementation of public-company financial controls and reporting requirements.
Work closely with senior management, external auditors, legal advisors, and other professional advisors.
Prepare and organize financial information and supporting documentation required for external reporting and audits.
Identify gaps in existing processes and implement practical solutions.
Improve reconciliation, approval, documentation, and reporting processes across the finance function.
Assist with audit readiness and coordinate responses to external auditor requests.
Develop clear and repeatable process documentation for the finance team.
Assess existing systems and recommend improvements where required.
Provide hands-on guidance and mentorship to accounting and finance staff.
Help establish a finance infrastructure capable of supporting the company's continued growth as a public organization.

Qualifications

CPA designation required.
7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience.
Experience working within a public company or recently public organization.
Strong understanding of financial reporting, accounting processes, internal controls, and audit requirements.
Experience implementing or improving financial processes and controls.
Strong knowledge of month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close procedures.
Experience working directly with external auditors.
Experience with public-company reporting and compliance requirements.
Strong analytical and process-improvement skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management abilities.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Director, FP&A – Corporate Functions
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Role Overview

The Director, Corporate Functions FP&A serves as the senior finance partner and trusted advisor to EA's Corporate Functions, including People Experience, Real Estate, Finance, Legal, and Corporate Development.

Reporting to the Head of Enterprise FP&A and Chief of Staff, you will lead financial planning, forecasting, investment evaluation, and performance accountability across Corporate Functions. As the Director you are responsible for ensuring capital is allocated effectively, investments are aligned to enterprise priorities, and leaders have the insights needed to make informed decisions. Success in this role requires the ability to translate complex financial and operational information into clear recommendations that influence executive decision-making and drive business outcomes.

The role leads and develops an established team of four directs and three shared service finance professionals, and is responsible for building organizational capability, fostering analytical excellence, and strengthening strategic business partnership across the Corporate Functions. This position follows a hybrid work model, requiring three days per week in an EA office. 

What You Will Do

Serve as the primary finance partner to Corporate Function executives, providing strategic counsel, financial insights, and decision support.
Lead annual planning, quarterly forecasting, and long-range planning activities across Corporate Functions, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities, planning assumptions, and financial objectives.
Drive scenario planning, risk assessment, and sensitivity analysis to support proactive decision-making and effective resource allocation. This work involves complex financial modeling and cross functional collaboration.
Provide financial leadership and decision support for significant corporate investments and strategic initiatives, including workplace experience and real estate, people programs, and enterprise capabilities.
Partner with business owners to evolve KPI frameworks and performance measures that connect functional investments to business outcomes, ensuring investment performance and value realization are effectively tracked and communicated.
Deliver monthly and quarterly management reporting, providing clear analysis of performance, key business drivers, financial risks, and opportunities.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of finance professionals, building strong analytical, forecasting, and business partnership capabilities.
Drive continuous improvement and financial excellence by leading planning and process enhancements, advancing operational effectiveness, and leveraging technology and AI-enabled solutions to improve planning, reporting, and decision support.
Partner with Enterprise FP&A to help establish and scale EA's connected financial planning framework, strengthening planning rigor, consistency, and transparency across Corporate Functions.

What You Bring

10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance, or related fields.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field. MBA, CFA, or CPA is valued
Proficiency in Accounting and general GAAP knowledge
5+ years of experience leading, coaching, and developing finance professionals and building an inclusive environment.
Experience serving as a finance partner to senior executives and influencing decisions in a complex, matrixed environment.
Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear and actionable insights.
Advanced financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with hands-on experience using modern ERP and FP&A planning platforms.
Experience leveraging AI and technology solutions to improve financial processes, analytics, and decision-making.

Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES

British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$160,700 - $224,700 CAD
California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$182,600 - $276,300 USD

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, 10 weeks paid time off to bond with baby, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Notre raison d’être

Chez Deloitte, notre raison d’être est d’avoir une influence marquante. Nous existons pour inspirer et aider nos gens, nos organisations, nos collectivités et nos pays à prospérer en créant un avenir meilleur. Notre travail soutient une société prospère où les gens peuvent s’épanouir et saisir des occasions. Il renforce la confiance des consommateurs et des entreprises, aide les organisations à trouver des moyens créatifs de déployer des capitaux, habilite des institutions sociales et économiques justes, fiables et efficaces, et permet à nos amis, à nos familles et à nos collectivités de profiter de la qualité de vie qui accompagne un avenir durable. Étant le plus grand cabinet de services professionnels détenu et exploité à 100 % par des Canadiens dans notre pays, nous sommes fiers de travailler aux côtés de nos clients pour avoir une influence positive sur tous les Canadiens.

En incarnant notre raison d’être, nous aurons une influence marquante.

Diversifiez votre carrière au sein du Cabinet.
Tirez parti d’avantages souples, proactifs et pratiques qui favorisent une culture de bien-être et la création de liens solides.
Approfondissez vos connaissances grâce au mentorat d’experts et à du coaching au travail.

--

À quoi ressemblera votre journée type

En tant que leader principal(e) d’Oracle EPM Planning (directeur(trice) principal(e)), vous serez responsable des programmes de planification d’entreprise et de transformation de la fonction finance pour façonner des solutions, de la gestion de relations avec des clients et de l’exécution de nombreuses missions.

À ce titre, vous devrez faire ce qui suit :

Superviser simultanément la prestation de bout en bout de l’architecture de solutions et de nombreuses missions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris l’étendue, le plan de travail, la gestion des risques et des problèmes (RAID), la gestion financière, la gestion de la qualité et les résultats globaux de la prestation.
Fournir des conseils sur les stratégies de transformation de la fonction finance et de planification d’entreprise.
Assumer la responsabilité de la conception de la solution et des décisions en matière d’architecture.
Diriger la définition des processus de planification pour l’état futur et des modèles d’exploitation en tirant parti des capacités d’Oracle EPM pour rehausser l’efficacité et les perspectives d’affaires.
Favoriser l’harmonisation entre les finances, les TI et les parties prenantes de la direction pour favoriser des processus décisionnels efficaces et veiller à la réussite des programmes.
Assurer la direction fonctionnelle des solutions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris la gamme complète de modules EPBCS.
Superviser la conception du modèle de planification et l’architecture des solutions (catalyseurs, hypothèses, scénarios, flux des travaux, production de rapports) et s’assurer que les solutions sont adaptables, durables et harmonisées aux objectifs du client.
Veiller à l’exécution de cas d’utilisation de grande qualité sur le plan de la planification, des prévisions et de la gestion du rendement.
Superviser les activités de test et de déploiement, notamment la stratégie de test, le tri des défectuosités, l’état de préparation aux essais d’acceptation par l’utilisateur et la planification du déploiement, afin de s’assurer que les solutions sont adoptées avec succès et créent la valeur commerciale attendue.
Favoriser le développement des affaires en faisant preuve de leadership sur le plan des offres de service, en effectuant des présentations auprès des clients et en assurant la gestion des relations.
Contribuer aux stratégies de mise en marché, à l’élaboration d’offres de service et au leadership d’opinion au sein de l’équipe Oracle EPM.
Diriger et encadrer des équipes de prestation dans le cadre de nombreuses missions, afin de promouvoir une solide discipline d’exécution et leur perfectionnement grâce au coaching, au mentorat et à une rétroaction de qualité.
Contribuer au recrutement, à l’intégration et au développement de capacités au sein de l’équipe Oracle EPM.
Demeurer au courant des nouveautés liées au produit Oracle EPM et intégrer les innovations pertinentes à la prestation de services, en particulier les capacités d’IA/IGR telles que la planification prédictive, Auto Predict et IPM Insights.
Aider les clients à mettre en œuvre des capacités de planification habilitées par l’IA pour améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions, automatiser la création de perspectives et améliorer les processus décisionnels.
Façonner les réflexions de clients sur le rôle de l’IA dans le cadre de la planification d’entreprise, et la création d’un équilibre entre l’innovation et la mise en œuvre de mesures pratiques qui créent de la valeur.

La personne retenue aura l’occasion de faire partie de notre premier cabinet de services-conseils qui travaille à la fine pointe de mises en œuvre d’Oracle Cloud. Vous travaillerez auprès d’une grande variété de clients et jouerez un rôle important dans certaines des mises en œuvre les plus stimulantes à l’échelle mondiale.

Renseignements sur l’équipe

L’équipe adopte et incarne la raison d’être du Cabinet – c’est-à-dire avoir une influence marquante –, tout en vous poussant à vous surpasser, vous-même et votre équipe, afin de trouver des solutions aux problèmes les plus importants de nos clients, de nos gens et de la société.

Veiller au perfectionnement de gens et d’équipes hautement performantes en leur offrant des occasions stimulantes et pertinentes.
Offrir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en obtenant un rendement élevé, tout en favorisant la collaboration entre les équipes et les régions.
Exercer une influence positive sur les clients, les équipes et les gens en donnant l’exemple et en établissant de solides relations.
Veiller à ce que les gens soient sur la même longueur d’onde et à ce que les priorités soient harmonisées aux objectifs d’affaires des clients et de Deloitte.

Assez parlé de nous, parlons de vous

Vous Avez Le Profil Suivant

Au moins huit années d’expérience dans la prestation de solutions Oracle EPM Planning dans des environnements de consultation ou d’entreprise.
Expérience dans la supervision de programmes de transformation de la fonction finance et de la planification d’entreprise pour améliorer les processus de budgétisation, de prévision et de présentation de l’information.
Expérience éprouvée dans la mise en œuvre de bout en bout d’Oracle EPM Planning tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, des exigences au déploiement et à la stabilisation.

new_jobs.title: Vice President Finance
new_jobs.description:
NWI Precision specializes in high-precision machining of helicopter masts, turbine shafts, engine thrust links, and nuclear pressure vessel components used in the aerospace and nuclear industries worldwide. NWI Precision’s 120,000 sq. ft. facility is located at 9 Fenmar Drive in Toronto. Our dedicated team pride themselves on delivering the highest quality products, to specifications and on time. NWI Precision is currently seeking a Vice President, Finance.

The Vice President, Finance is the financial leader of the manufacturing facility, accountable for safeguarding assets, ensuring the accuracy of financial reporting, and providing actionable insights that directly improve P&L results and cash flow. This role partners closely with the CEO, the Senior Leadership Team, Corporate Shared Services and Board of Directors to enhance profitability, improve cost controls, accelerate operational efficiency, and deliver measurable financial outcomes, while ensuring compliance with corporate and regulatory requirements. This role has full leadership responsibility for the finance function at the site, with all finance team members reporting into the position directly or indirectly, and is accountable for building a high-performing finance organization that supports both operational execution and strategic decision-making.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES :

Financial Leadership and Governance

Lead the full finance function for the site, ensuring strong execution, clear accountability, and alignment across financial reporting, FP&A, cost accounting, inventory management, and compliance activities.
Serve as the senior finance leader on the site leadership team, providing financial guidance to support both day-to-day decision-making and long-term business strategy.
Establish and maintain a disciplined finance operating model, including policies, processes, controls, and performance expectations across the department.
Lead the preparation and presentation of financial results, forecasts, and business risks to the Board of Directors, ensuring clear communication of performance, outlook, and key decision points.

Financial Reporting & Controls

Ensure timely and accurate reporting of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results in accordance with Canadian GAAP (ASPE) and corporate standards.
Oversee cost accounting, inventory valuation, and product costing processes to ensure accuracy and transparency.
Maintain strong internal control environment and compliance with corporate/business internal policies, audit standards, and safeguarding of plant assets.
Accountable for early identification and resolution of risks or discrepancies that could materially affect reported financials
Ensure finance processes and reporting structures are scalable, disciplined, and responsive to both business needs and corporate requirements.

Financial Planning & Analysis

Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning, ensuring alignment with company objectives and measurable performance targets.
Provide clear, actionable analysis of variances and trends that directly inform operational decision-making and drive corrective actions.
Evaluate, prioritize, and track financial impact of cost savings initiatives, capital investment projects, and productivity improvements.
Own delivery of cash flow visibility and forecasting accuracy, including proactive working capital management.
Lead an integrated planning process that connects financial forecasts, operational assumptions, capital requirements, and business priorities into a coherent view of plant performance.
Provide forward-looking financial leadership to support resource allocation, business cases, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.

Cash Flow Management

Own site cash flow planning, visibility, and performance, ensuring the business has timely insight into short, medium, and long-term liquidity requirements.
Drive cash flow 13 weeks forecasts, including analysis of operating cash flow, capital expenditures, inventory movements, customer collections, supplier payments, and other key drivers of liquidity.

Operational Partnership

Act as a strategic business partner to the President and the Senior Leadership Team
Provide financial guidance that results in improved margins, reduced waste, and achievement of plant productivity goals.
Support lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and efficiency projects with value-focused financial analysis and business cases.
Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs), linking financial performance with operational drivers and holding functions accountable to achieve targets.
Reduce production supplies costs over time through analysis of usage, benchmarking, and best practices adoption.
Increase plant profitability by driving costs down through improved productivity, efficiency, and elimination of non-value-added activities.
Guide operations and support functions in achieving profitability targets, ensuring accountability against plan.
Influence decisions across operations, supply chain, quality, engineering, and support functions by translating financial and operational data into clear priorities and actions.

Inventory and Cost Management

Ensure accurate tracking, valuation, and reporting of raw materials, WIP, and finished goods inventory.
Lead the physical inventory and cycle counting processes, ensuring variances are explained, contained, and prevented going forward.
Oversee cost roll-ups, bills of material, and program specific labor/overhead rate setting to ensure accurate product costing and accountability for margin realization vs. planned.
Initiate, evaluate, and deliver continuous improvement projects designed to remove costs month-over-month from the business.
Drive working capital discipline across the site, including inventory optimization, cash flow visibility, and timely escalation of inventory, receivables, or cost risks.

Compliance, Audit and Risk Management

Ensure compliance with tax, government, and corporate reporting requirements at the business unit level.
Support external and internal audit processes, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
Identify financial risks and recommend mitigation strategies with ownership of follow-through until risk is remediated.
Own the finance governance framework for the site, including audit readiness, policy compliance, control effectiveness, and escalation of material issues.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team, including performance management, succession planning, and capability building.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement, ensuring a focus on results and operational excellence.
Partner with cross-functional leaders to provide financial insights and recommendations, building a responsive and trusted finance organization.

EXPECTATIONS

Consistently improve profitability by delivering measurable margin expansion and recurring cost reductions such as production supplies and other overhead versus plan.
Maintain accurate, timely financials and forecasts, with clear root-cause variance analysis and corrective actions that keep results within agreed tolerances.
Improve cash flow performance through accurate rolling forecasts, stronger working capital discipline, and proactive management of liquidity risks and opportunities.
Drive continuous improvement by initiating, evaluating, and delivering cost takeout and productivity projects that generate visible monthly savings and efficiency gains.
Strengthen working capital and operational performance through improved inventory accuracy and turns, effective cash flow management, and disciplined cost control across operations and support functions.
Build a high-performing finance team by coaching and mentoring staff, executing succession plans, and being recognized by Operations as a proactive, accountable business partner.
Establish a culture of accountability across the finance organization, where ownership, responsiveness, and measurable business impact are expected at all levels.

QUALIFICATIONS :

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration. MBA is an asset.
CPA, CA, or equivalent designation is an asset.

EXPERIENCE/KNOWLEDGE:

10+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant leadership responsibility in a manufacturing environment and prior ownership of plant controllership, finance management, or finance director-level responsibilities.
Experience building or upgrading finance processes, controls, and team capability in a manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of cost accounting, inventory management, operations and ERP systems (Syteline/Epicor or similar preferred).
Proven experience partnering with operations to drive cost improvements and efficiencies with demonstrated margin or cash flow impact.
Manufacturing environment mandatory, aerospace or other highly regulated manufacturing experience is an asset.

new_jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Role Overview

The Director, Corporate Functions FP&A serves as the senior finance partner and trusted advisor to EA's Corporate Functions, including People Experience, Real Estate, Finance, Legal, and Corporate Development.

Reporting to the Head of Enterprise FP&A and Chief of Staff, you will lead financial planning, forecasting, investment evaluation, and performance accountability across Corporate Functions. As the Director you are responsible for ensuring capital is allocated effectively, investments are aligned to enterprise priorities, and leaders have the insights needed to make informed decisions. Success in this role requires the ability to translate complex financial and operational information into clear recommendations that influence executive decision-making and drive business outcomes.

The role leads and develops an established team of four directs and three shared service finance professionals, and is responsible for building organizational capability, fostering analytical excellence, and strengthening strategic business partnership across the Corporate Functions. This position follows a hybrid work model, requiring three days per week in an EA office. 

What You Will Do

Serve as the primary finance partner to Corporate Function executives, providing strategic counsel, financial insights, and decision support.
Lead annual planning, quarterly forecasting, and long-range planning activities across Corporate Functions, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities, planning assumptions, and financial objectives.
Drive scenario planning, risk assessment, and sensitivity analysis to support proactive decision-making and effective resource allocation. This work involves complex financial modeling and cross functional collaboration.
Provide financial leadership and decision support for significant corporate investments and strategic initiatives, including workplace experience and real estate, people programs, and enterprise capabilities.
Partner with business owners to evolve KPI frameworks and performance measures that connect functional investments to business outcomes, ensuring investment performance and value realization are effectively tracked and communicated.
Deliver monthly and quarterly management reporting, providing clear analysis of performance, key business drivers, financial risks, and opportunities.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of finance professionals, building strong analytical, forecasting, and business partnership capabilities.
Drive continuous improvement and financial excellence by leading planning and process enhancements, advancing operational effectiveness, and leveraging technology and AI-enabled solutions to improve planning, reporting, and decision support.
Partner with Enterprise FP&A to help establish and scale EA's connected financial planning framework, strengthening planning rigor, consistency, and transparency across Corporate Functions.

What You Bring

10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance, or related fields.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field. MBA, CFA, or CPA is valued
Proficiency in Accounting and general GAAP knowledge
5+ years of experience leading, coaching, and developing finance professionals and building an inclusive environment.
Experience serving as a finance partner to senior executives and influencing decisions in a complex, matrixed environment.
Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear and actionable insights.
Advanced financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with hands-on experience using modern ERP and FP&A planning platforms.
Experience leveraging AI and technology solutions to improve financial processes, analytics, and decision-making.

Pay Transparency - North America

If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. À quoi ressemblera votre journée type

En tant que leader principal(e) d’Oracle EPM Planning (directeur(trice) principal(e)), vous serez responsable des programmes de planification d’entreprise et de transformation de la fonction finance pour façonner des solutions, de la gestion de relations avec des clients et de l’exécution de nombreuses missions.

À ce titre, vous devrez faire ce qui suit :

Superviser simultanément la prestation de bout en bout de l’architecture de solutions et de nombreuses missions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris l’étendue, le plan de travail, la gestion des risques et des problèmes (RAID), la gestion financière, la gestion de la qualité et les résultats globaux de la prestation.
Fournir des conseils sur les stratégies de transformation de la fonction finance et de planification d’entreprise.
Assumer la responsabilité de la conception de la solution et des décisions en matière d’architecture.
Diriger la définition des processus de planification pour l’état futur et des modèles d’exploitation en tirant parti des capacités d’Oracle EPM pour rehausser l’efficacité et les perspectives d’affaires.
Favoriser l’harmonisation entre les finances, les TI et les parties prenantes de la direction pour favoriser des processus décisionnels efficaces et veiller à la réussite des programmes.
Assurer la direction fonctionnelle des solutions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris la gamme complète de modules EPBCS.
Superviser la conception du modèle de planification et l’architecture des solutions (catalyseurs, hypothèses, scénarios, flux des travaux, production de rapports) et s’assurer que les solutions sont adaptables, durables et harmonisées aux objectifs du client.
Veiller à l’exécution de cas d’utilisation de grande qualité sur le plan de la planification, des prévisions et de la gestion du rendement.
Superviser les activités de test et de déploiement, notamment la stratégie de test, le tri des défectuosités, l’état de préparation aux essais d’acceptation par l’utilisateur et la planification du déploiement, afin de s’assurer que les solutions sont adoptées avec succès et créent la valeur commerciale attendue.
Favoriser le développement des affaires en faisant preuve de leadership sur le plan des offres de service, en effectuant des présentations auprès des clients et en assurant la gestion des relations.
Contribuer aux stratégies de mise en marché, à l’élaboration d’offres de service et au leadership d’opinion au sein de l’équipe Oracle EPM.
Diriger et encadrer des équipes de prestation dans le cadre de nombreuses missions, afin de promouvoir une solide discipline d’exécution et leur perfectionnement grâce au coaching, au mentorat et à une rétroaction de qualité.
Contribuer au recrutement, à l’intégration et au développement de capacités au sein de l’équipe Oracle EPM.
Demeurer au courant des nouveautés liées au produit Oracle EPM et intégrer les innovations pertinentes à la prestation de services, en particulier les capacités d’IA/IGR telles que la planification prédictive, Auto Predict et IPM Insights.
Aider les clients à mettre en œuvre des capacités de planification habilitées par l’IA pour améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions, automatiser la création de perspectives et améliorer les processus décisionnels.
Façonner les réflexions de clients sur le rôle de l’IA dans le cadre de la planification d’entreprise, et la création d’un équilibre entre l’innovation et la mise en œuvre de mesures pratiques qui créent de la valeur.

La personne retenue aura l’occasion de faire partie de notre premier cabinet de services-conseils qui travaille à la fine pointe de mises en œuvre d’Oracle Cloud. Vous travaillerez auprès d’une grande variété de clients et jouerez un rôle important dans certaines des mises en œuvre les plus stimulantes à l’échelle mondiale.
